correctness.rationale: Exact coordinatewise three/two-state normal form proves labeled counts. For any atom permutation each subset-input orbit is controlled by the cycles of its stabilizing power, hence Burnside proves the unlabeled counts. Disjoint pairs in nontrivial input orbits force independent Bernoulli(1/3) equalities, at least 2^(k-1)/3 of them; their 5/9 chance yields a summable error over all k! permutations. A standalone enumeration independently exhausts k=1,2 and computes Burnside for k<=5.
